 * Usage:
 *   npx tsx scripts/cli-game.ts                          # interactive, fallback mode

 *   npx tsx scripts/cli-game.ts --encounters=5           # custom encounter count
 *   npx tsx scripts/cli-game.ts --verbose                # show full narrative flow
 *   npx tsx scripts/cli-game.ts --json                   # machine-readable JSON output
 *   npx tsx scripts/cli-game.ts --new-game               # start fresh (delete saved progress)
 */

387: function pickRandom<T>(arr: readonly T[]): T {
388:   const index = Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length);
389:   return arr[index];
390: }

392: export function getFallback(modality: Modality, _line: Line, stage: Stage): FallbackContent {
393:   switch (modality) {

399:         case 'Amber': return pickRandom(LANGUAGE_REFLECTIVE_AMBER);
400:         case 'Orange': return pickRandom(LANGUAGE_REFLECTIVE_ORANGE);
401:         case 'Green': return pickRandom(LANGUAGE_REFLECTIVE_GREEN);
402:         case 'Turquoise': return pickRandom(LANGUAGE_REFLECTIVE_TURQUOISE);
403:         case 'White': return pickRandom(LANGUAGE_REFLECTIVE_WHITE);
404:         default: return GENERIC_LANGUAGE_REFLECTIVE;
405:       }
406:     case 'ScenarioChoice':
